cost: Resolve O(path+expanded link bytes+sum log fanout); COW clones shared directory maps O(sum fanouts), shared content O(old bytes) on append/At/truncate. Snapshot O(cwd bytes); restore also drops unshared divergent tree. dump O(tree+content+path output).
description: Arc tree, symlink resolution, edits, snapshots and explicit transfers.
forward: State S=(root,cwd,clock,next_ino,usage,tmp;limits,journal,fault). Resolution expands links at most40 hops. Validated edits tick then COW mutate; file bytes and node counts update. snapshot captures first6 fields while journal records; restore reuses root and copies cwd, restoring counters except deliberate fault.
inverse: Restored snapshot determines represented state but admits any intervening mutation/journal history; limits/fault remain external. Reads admit any unseen tree; overwrite loses old bytes; dump/fingerprint do not uniquely identify histories.
limitations: Finite checks only; partial source syntax, no expanded semantic AST.
